name: Twilio MCP Server (Twilio Alpha)
summary: Twilio Labs monorepo exposing Twilio's public APIs as MCP tools, plus a generic OpenAPI-to-MCP server.
description: Two packages: `@twilio-alpha/mcp`, an MCP server for all of Twilio's public API, and `openapi-mcp-server`, which serves any OpenAPI spec as MCP tools. Because the full API is large, filter with `--services` and `--tags` to fit model context. Twilio advises not running community MCP servers alongside the official one to limit injection risk. Experimental (Twilio Alpha).

agent_access.notes: npx -y @twilio-alpha/mcp ACCOUNT_SID/API_KEY:API_SECRET; Twilio usage charges apply.
